Revision: df3fb154fb982fb83f649de8646d4af6a0cb16b3

The four behaviorContract files are byte-identical copies used to prove the approved behavior
fingerprint. The upstream SKILL.md is stored as SKILL.md.fixture so repository capability
inventory does not mistake test data for a live capability; tests restore its canonical name only
inside their temporary cache. LICENSE is copied from the same upstream revision and applies to the
fixture files.
